defs.def: that is not being used or is not needed at the present time 不用的；闲置的

ex.s: No area was spared or unaffected, from the foggy northern coast to the Sierra Nevada Mountains to the San Gabriels above Los Angeles.
ex.t: 从多雾的北部海岸，到内华达山脉，再到洛杉矶上方的圣加布里埃尔山，没有哪个地区幸免或不受影响。

ex.s: “I love working with kids, so I just decided to take a spare bedroom and turn it into a one-room cooking school called Sprouts Cooking School. ”
ex.t: "我喜欢和孩子们一起工作，所以我决定腾出一间闲置卧室，把它改造成一个名为'豆芽烹饪学校'的单间烹饪学校。"

defs.def: kept in case you need to replace the one you usually use; extra 备用的；外加的

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: “我正翻页准备下一页，但翻页带起的气流把备用的谱子从谱架上吹掉了，”蒂特顿先生说，“幸好我接住了它们并放回去。”

ex.s: So, I called Directory Assistance, got put through to our landlady’s managing agent, and had a spare key sent to me with just enough time to get back in before the actors arrived.
ex.t: 于是我打了查号台，转接到房东的代理处，让人送了一把备用钥匙过来，刚好能在演员到达之前赶回去开门。

defs.def: available to do what you want with rather than work 空闲的；空余的

ex.s: In his spare time though he goes on stage beside pianist Maria Raspopova — not as a musician but as her page turner.
ex.t: 但在空闲时间，他登上舞台，站在钢琴家玛丽亚·拉斯波波娃身旁——不是作为音乐家，而是作为她的翻谱员。

ex.s: Before her first novel was published, Rowling was working as a teacher in Edinburgh and using every spare moment to work on its manuscript.
ex.t: 在她的第一部小说出版之前，罗林在爱丁堡担任教师，并利用每一个空余时间来完成它的手稿。

ex.s: He did all of this in his spare time.
ex.t: 他在空闲时间做了这一切

ex.s: In their spare time, they are interesting in planting vegetables in their garden, that is on the rooftop of their house.
ex.t: 在业余时间，他们对在花园里种菜很感兴趣，花园就在他们房子的屋顶上。
给学生更多的空闲时间。

ex.s: We managed to leave this spot to climb higher because of the spare time until sunset.
ex.t: 由于距离日落还有空闲时间，我们设法离开这个地点爬到更高的地方。

ex.s: Museums must compete     45    people’s spare time and money with other amusements.
ex.t: 博物馆必须与其他娱乐活动竞争45个人的空余时间和金钱。

ex.s: He even moderates the amount of sugar that guests have in their tea, going so far as to cut up the cubes into smaller pieces in his spare time.
ex.t: 他甚至温和了宾客茶中含的糖量，以至于在业余时间将立方体切成小块。

ex.s: MENTAL HEALTH 1 Ask questions about what people do in their spare time, such as reading, watching TV, using phone/Internet, playing video games, etc.
ex.t: MENAL HEALTH 1询问人们在业余时间做些什么，如阅读，观看电视，使用电话/互联网，玩电子游戏等。

ex.s: John has devoted his spare time which help disabled people.
ex.t: John将业余时间奉献给了帮助残疾人。

defs.def: thin, and usually quite tall 瘦的；瘦高的
to make sth such as time or money available to sb or for sth, especially when it requires an effort for you to do this 抽出；拨出；留出；匀出

ex.s: Then I can spare some time to learn it again, such that we can practice together on every day.
ex.t: 然后，我可以腾出一些时间再次学习它，这样我们就可以每天一起练习。

ex.s: Finally, with just two minutes to spare we rolled into the bus station.
ex.t: 最后，我们提前两分钟赶到了汽车站。

defs.def: to save sb/yourself from having to go through an unpleasant experience 省得；免去

ex.s: This approach spared me the discomfort of having to over-explain.
ex.t: 这种做法让我免去了不得不过度解释的尴尬。

defs.def: to allow sb/sth to escape harm, damage or death, especially when others do not escape it 饶恕；赦免；放过；使逃脱
to do everything possible to achieve sth or to do sth well without trying to limit the time or money involved 不吝惜（时间、金钱）
to work as hard as possible 不遗余力
an extra thing that you keep in case you need to replace the one you usually use (used especially about a tyre of a car) 备用品；备用轮胎
有些旧型号汽车可能不好买配件。
